text:
jessica_support: Hey team — customer Mike (acme-rt) reporting sustained 429 spikes when hitting their dedicated pool. Says ramp from 0 to necessary capacity takes ~45s and requests queue/timeout. They see "attach: handshake timeout" in agent logs. Repro steps attached. Urgent, customer on paid plan. /cc @lucas_sre

lucas_sre: looking. can you paste the customer request-id and region?

jessica_support: Request IDs: req-8f3a2 / req-8f3a3. Region: us-west-2. Customer says scale events triggered but attach keeps failing with 500s then 429s. Logs show "handshake backoff: rate limited by operator" around the time. Customer tried setting min_replicas=1 but still slow.

anita_eng_platform: pinging autoscaler logs for that time window. do we have any recent imagepull or auth errors? Also any recent quota/billing holds on that account?

tim_ops: checked billing, account active. registry pull ok. I see repeated "attach failed: token rotate in-progress" around 3045001205-3045001230. Could be IAM rotation interfering with instance registration.

jessica_support: customer attached a snippet:

```
GET /redwood/dedicated/acme-rt HTTP/1.1
x-request-id: req-8f3a2
-> 202: scaling
-> 500: attach error: handshake timeout
-> 429: pool exhausted
```

lucas_sre: hmm. autoscaler shows probe succeeded but attach timed out. This smells like probe concurrency + warmchain headroom miscalc. Could be KV cache cold causing slow container startup. Any noisy tenant on same host? check node metrics.

anita_eng_platform: found noisy neighbor at same AZ: tenant "beta-labs" had a big burst and increased GPU memory usage, preempted some slices. I'm seeing spike in node-level OOM kills and increased kube-scheduler latency. Suggesting capacity contention causing attach handshake delay.

tim_ops: mitigation: temporarily increase min_replicas to 2 for acme-rt and set fallback_model to smaller variant to reduce memory. Also we can bump attach timeout to 40s for their route. Will coordinate with infra.

jessica_support: customer ok with temp config. How do we set attach timeout? any CLI?

lucas_sre: run:

```
rwctl routes update --name acme-rt-prod --attach-timeout 40s --min-replicas 2
```

I'll also add a canary autoscaler policy to prefer isolated nodes: set nodeSelector for dedicated pools.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by @lucas_sre (change-id: ch-8892). Warm pool pre-population started.

customer_mike: Thanks — initial improvement. 429s dropping. Still see occasional 500s when hitting peak.

anita_eng_platform: follow-up: we'll provision a dedicated warmchain slice for them in az-a for next 24h and monitor. Also investigating token-rotation race that timed attach. Filing bug: #INF-7124.

tim_ops: I'll run a postmortem and revert configs after stable. Assigning sev3.

jessica_support: thanks team. I'll update customer and close loop. :white_check_mark:
